question: The number of Pawn in chess is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**16**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a standard **game of chess,** each player starts with eight pawns, making a** total of 16 pawns **on the board.
 
• In addition to pawns, each player also starts with the following pieces:
 
 
• **Rooks:** Also known as castles, each player has two rooks. They start in the corners of the board.
 
• **Knights:** Each player has two knights. They are positioned next to the rooks.
 
• **Bishops:** Like knights, each player has two bishops. They start next to the knights, closer to the center of the board.
 
• **Queen:** Each player has one queen, which is placed on the square of its own color (white queen on a white square, black queen on a black square). The queen starts next to the king.
 
• **King:** Each player has one king, positioned next to the queen.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The objective of the game is to protect your own king while putting the opponent's king in checkmate.
 
• These pieces together make up the initial setup of a standard chessboard.
 
• Each piece has its own unique way of moving and capturing other pieces, contributing to the complexity and depth of the game.
